answer: A canyon is one fake identity. The ember is the registry of anchors, one entry per identity, and a newcomer must replay the whole audit, proof by proof, each proof checked by one incumbent of a fixed roster, one check per epoch. Every earlier anchor's proof stays in it, so the thousandth canyon replays a thousand proofs where an honest key replays one. Cedar is minted only when honest service is judged, and every check burns cedar, so a clone pays cedar for the growing history; splitting buys nothing. It breaks if one owner holds the roster, or the audit forks.
